title: Mended Corner · 수선이 남긴 자리

concept.origin: GPT Image generation supplied as the starting concept for this artwork
concept.metadata_note: The supplied PNG is retained byte-for-byte, including its caBX provenance payload. No independent C2PA signature/trust-chain validation is claimed.

three_dimensional_artwork.geometry: Original procedural meshes and curves, made independently from the concept
three_dimensional_artwork.materials: Original procedural materials; no imported texture maps or HDRI
three_dimensional_artwork.image_type: Actual Cycles render of the saved editable model; not a generated concept image

interpretation.bench: An old household bench repaired by a fictional neighbourhood carpenter, not newly built from workshop scrap
changes_from_concept: Thin 34 mm slatted seat with a separate apron instead of a massive worktop
14 mm deep fitted repair in the front slat rather than a patch through the entire front structure
Independent 52 mm camera and more intimate lamp placement
A continuous modeled throw plus a closed folded volume
Static rain geometry and an abstract non-geographic evening beyond one pane

limits: Not an exact reconstruction or CAD/fabrication design
No structural, woodworking, electrical, glazing-safety or building-code validation
No user personal history is depicted
No changes to Glass Refuge, the canonical game, or any GUI session

publication_metadata.scope: 렌더 PNG 두 사본의 텍스트 메타데이터만 제거했다. 원본 생성 콘셉트와 C2PA, Blender 장면, PNG IDAT 및 디코딩 픽셀은 변경하지 않았다. 원본 파일 해시는 이력이며 현재 공개 파일 해시와 구분한다.
